requirements.evidence: Current build has piece:0,0,0;half-n with drawer:0#0,0#cut on its south cut face – drawer requirement met. SPIKE_CLASH / socket rules prevent co-location on same corner; touching placement refused.

finish.summary: Built half-n base at 0,0,0 with drawer on its cut face; spike co-location at same corner unmet due to configurator clash – full-base triangle allows spike but forbids drawer, half-base allows drawer but provides no spike socket at same junction. Mesh clear, LOOSE_BODY warning remains.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
